item: R826 stage 4a: segment confirmed read-only before a hot-journal rollback, live writer journals never rolled back, cross-process bulk-load claims
key_paths: src/database/segment_open.py; src/database/segment_write.py; src/database/connect.py; src/database/segments.py; src/safety/data_scope.py; tests/test_segment_write.py; tests/test_segment_bulk.py
summary: Hot journal = SQLite's own read-only refusal (sqlcipher3: wrong-passphrase chained from code 8); immutable read-only confirm of schema, identity and generation before rollback, else file and journal byte-identical; leases/segment-load.<hex>.claim honoured by every process's settle, dead owner swept, unreadable after 10 s; switch stays off. Torn-page recovery is stage 4d (R854).
